background_worker_help:
Background Worker

Usage: background-worker [-c|--config-file ARG] [--galley-config-file ARG]

Available options:
  -c,--config-file ARG     Config file to load
                           (default: "/etc/wire/background-worker/conf/background-worker.yaml")
  --galley-config-file ARG Galley config file to load
                           (default: "/etc/wire/galley/conf/galley.yaml")
  -h,--help                Show this help text
purpose: Inventory/discovery only; cases listed, not executed by this receipt.
